description: This is a Java test class for the DevOpsRoute, testing HTTP endpoints related to DevOps piggyback commands. It sets up test cases for executing piggyback commands and handling invalid JSON input.

classes.name: DevOpsRouteTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the DevOpsRoute HTTP endpoints related to piggyback commands in a Java environment.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting up the ActorSystem, ProtocolAdapterProvider, DevOpsRoute instance, and test route.

methods.name: testPiggyback
methods.description: Tests the /devops/piggyback endpoint for a valid piggyback command, expecting an OK response.

methods.name: testPiggybackWithJsonException
methods.description: Tests the /devops/piggyback endpoint with malformed JSON input, expecting a BAD REQUEST response.

methods.name: getInsecureDevopsConfig
methods.description: Creates a default insecure DevOps configuration for testing purposes.
